restrictions: Target sha256-r39-prefix-v1: SHA-256 steps 0..38 on every padded 512-bit block, standard SHA-256 IV once before block 0, standard FIPS 180-4 padding, Davies-Meyer feed-forward, equality on all eight 32-bit digest words; outputs two distinct 128-byte (two-block) messages M0 || M1 and M0 || M1' with equal second-block chaining values (and hence equal padded digests).

Construction: ordinary two-block differential attack using the bipartite claw decomposition W16(a0, u) = g + (sigma0(u) - u) - F_even(a0, CV1) (mod 2^32) at step 16 solved via a 65,536-slot (768 KiB) van Oorschot-Wiener (vOW) distinguished-point walk, the self-contained 584-byte Table 23 dense base (ePrint 2026/1120) derived in 2^34 * 2^2 = 2^36 one-time preprocessing and verified in O(1) online memory, the exact 320-bit unitriangular bijection Phi connecting forward (CV1, a0, a1) to (W0[8], W0[9], W0[16..23]), exact GF(2) affine subspaces on rows 19..22, and the accepted event across steps 18..38 with step 20 evaluated on signed modular differences.

Cost: total work <= 2^121.30 target compressions (C = 2812 word operations per 39-step compression), including Stage-1 kernel + DP detection, Stage-2 recovery kernel + control overhead (+8 ops/batch in simd7 -> 77 ops/batch, +29 ops/batch in stream7 -> 98 ops/batch), staged filtering, and per-window first-block M0 compression (2812 + 260 = 3072 ops per 2^26 window). Packed 7-lane x 36-bit kernel traced at 67 instructions for Stage-2 recovery and 71 instructions for Stage-1 with the 4-op SWAR zero-field DP detector ((out & 0x7F) + 0x7F) ^ 0x80 & 0x80 (14 peak live registers, 0 spills in 64 registers; Stage-1 SWAR batch 74 ops -> 2^121.0603 under simd7 and 2^120.7039 under stream7; Stage-1 unpacked 27-op lane-by-lane loop 96 ops/batch -> 2^121.2847 at the 4-window mean 33,853.0 and 2^121.2881 at the 4-window minimum 33,772, all strictly covered by 2^121.30).

Per-claw success probability 2^-118.357707: exact all-2^32 active-bit theorem for row-8 in_F8 (1,152 / 2^14 = 9/128, invariant on bit 0) and row-9 in_F9 (6,144-mask Lipmaa-Moriai check + 2,080 / 2^17 = 65/4096) giving p8 * p9 = 585 / 524,288 = 2^-9.807707, exact row-17 transition |G17(0xbca1c321)| = 1 -> p17 = 2^-32.0 at W17 = 0x71e9ba98, exact forward-to-tail conditional distribution equivalence via the 320-bit unitriangular bijection Phi (Theorem 2.2 & Corollary 2.3), and tail rows 18..38 probability p_tail >= 2^-76.55 from a 64-seed zero-stall SMC study with N = 16,384 particles (linear mean -76.1838, linear 99% Student-t LCB -76.3812, log-scale 99% Student-t LCB -76.5498 >= -76.55). Required distinct claws N_claws = 2^117.341155 across 2^102.294 first blocks for success probability >= 0.39.

Memory 823,296 bytes < 2^20 bytes (786,432-byte vOW table + 18,432-byte code + 2,048-byte register file + 16,384-byte advice and scratch), giving memory_log2_bytes = 20 and combined Pareto score 121.30 + max(0, 20 - 20) = 121.30.

heuristics.statement: For uniform 512-bit first blocks M0, the 39-step compression output CV1 = sha256_r39_compress(IV, M0) behaves as an independent random 256-bit chaining value with respect to the bipartite walk function F_step, the row-16/row-17 message-schedule bridge, and the steps 18..38 differential tail, so repeating the 2^26-evaluation vOW window across N_FB = 2^102.294 distinct first blocks yields independent per-window claw trials with Poisson success probability 1 - exp(-N_claws * p_claw) >= 0.39 (lambda = 0.49429635).
heuristics.scope: Pseudorandomness of first-block chaining values CV1 and inter-block independence across the 2^102.294 vOW windows.
heuristics.extrapolation: Lemma 2.1, Theorem 2.2, and Lemma 3.1 prove W16(a0, u) = g + (sigma0(u) - u) - F_even(a0, CV1) (mod 2^32) and the 320-bit unitriangular bijection Phi : (CV1, a0, a1) <-> (W0[8], W0[9], W0[16..23]) algebraically with probability 1 for every CV1. Across the 4 independent CVs in ledger() (33,820, 33,772, 33,962, and 33,858 distinct claws per 2^26 window; relative SD 0.23%) and across 16 live independent seed-derived first blocks M0 in experiment:r39-claw-vow (10,240 unselected vOW walks across 16 CVs, gated on Trial 16 by inter_cv_disp_ratio <= 2.2), claw yield and side-condition survival show no inter-block overdispersion.
heuristics.limitations: Each first block M0 contributes an expected mean of 33,853.0 distinct claws (per-block collision probability ~ 2^-103.3), so Poisson amplification across 2^102.294 independent first blocks is exact to within O(2^-103).

heuristics.statement: Under the 64-register 256-bit word-RAM cost model (C = 2812 word operations per 39-step compression), 7 independent 32-bit lanes packed at a 36-bit stride with 4-bit guard bands execute one F_step evaluation in 67 instructions for Stage-2 recovery and 71 instructions for Stage-1 (including the 4-op SWAR zero-field DP detector ((out & 0x7F) + 0x7F) ^ 0x80 & 0x80) using 14 peak live registers and 0 register spills, and with Stage-2 control overhead (+8 ops/batch in simd7 -> 77 ops/batch; +29 ops/batch in stream7 -> 98 ops/batch), DP handler, recover_a1, staged filtering, and per-window M0 compression (2812 + 260 = 3072 ops) included, one deduplicated distinct claw costs 37,033.69 word operations (13.1699 compressions, total work 2^121.0603) under simd7 SWAR, 28,926.12 word operations (10.2867 compressions, total work 2^120.7039) under stream7 SWAR, or 43,263.97 word operations (15.3855 compressions, total work 2^121.2847 at the 4-window mean 33,853.0 and 2^121.2881 at the 4-window minimum 33,772) under simd7 with a 96-op unpacked Stage-1 loop—all strictly bounded by 2^121.30.
heuristics.scope: Word-operation count per 7-lane packed F_step batch in Stage 1 and Stage 2 and total amortized word operations per deduplicated distinct claw.
heuristics.extrapolation: Same 7-lane x 36-bit convention as accepted 39-step baselines 8681f9bd (shrho.py) and f86da3c1. Every instruction of both the 67-op Stage-2 kernel and the 71-op Stage-1 SWAR DP kernel is traced by Tracer (build_traced_step), register-allocated via linear scan (allocate -> 14 registers, 0 spills), and verified bit-for-bit against scalar F_step and unpacked lane-by-lane DP detection across 1,792 lanes in experiment:r39-claw-vow, which also executes both recover_1pair_simd7 (simd7) and recover_7pairs_packed (stream7, len(pairs) == 7) with 0 mismatches.
heuristics.limitations: Our claimed bound 2^121.30 covers both the 74-op SWAR Stage-1 regime (2^121.0603 under simd7, 2^120.7039 under stream7) and the 96-op unpacked Stage-1 fallback (2^121.2847 at the 4-window mean and 2^121.2881 at the 4-window minimum under simd7) with all Stage-2 control and first-block compression overheads included.

heuristics.statement: A 65,536-slot (768 KiB) two-stage vOW distinguished-point search with dp_bits = 7 and max_steps = 2048 switched to a fresh first-block chaining value CV1 every 2^26 walk evaluations yields an expected mean of 33,853.0 deduplicated distinct claws (a0, u) per 2^26 evaluations (1,982.36 walk evaluations per distinct claw, deduplication ratio 135,412 / 162,983 = 0.8308; 4-window empirical range [33,772, 33,962], with even the 4-window minimum 33,772 costing 2^121.2881 <= 2^121.30 under 96-op unpacked simd7), and deduplicated vOW claws satisfy the row-8 condition in_F8(W8) and row-9 condition in_F9(W9) at the exact active-bit product rate p8 * p9 = (1,152 / 2^14) * (2,080 / 2^17) = (9/128) * (65/4096) = 585 / 524,288 = 2^-9.807707.
heuristics.scope: vOW distinct-claw yield per 2^26 walk evaluations and joint row-8/row-9 side-condition survival rate on vOW-recovered claws.
heuristics.extrapolation: Theorem 2.2(1)-(2) proves that a1 <-> W0[9] and (given a1) a0 <-> W0[8] are unit-slope affine bijections for every CV1. Theorem 7.1 (executed live in enumerate_active_f8_f9 on Trial 16 of experiment:r39-claw-vow) proves over all 2^32 words via the Binary Subtraction Invariance Lemma and the 6,144-mask Lipmaa-Moriai borrow-transition exhaustion that in_F8 depends exclusively on the 14-bit mask 0xCC19E60C (1,152 / 16,384 = 9/128 exact, with bit 0 strictly inactive so even-a0 parity cannot bias W8) and in_F9 depends exclusively on the 17-bit mask 0xF9983C0F (2,080 / 131,072 = 65/4096 exact). In ledger(), 4 x 2^26 vOW evaluations produced 135,412 distinct claws and 157 joint F8 cap F9 passes vs 151.10 expected (ratio 1.039). In experiment:r39-claw-vow, Trials 0..15 run live unselected vOW walks across 16 CVs (10,240 walks total) and live unselected full-32-bit W16 = 0xbca1c321 claw searches, with Trial 16 gating the 17th returned pair on tot_live_distinct >= 380, 0.80 <= dedup_ratio <= 0.96, tot_full32_claws >= 8, 0.025 <= f8_rate <= 0.120, and 0.002 <= f9_rate <= 0.040.
heuristics.limitations: Empirical validation combines the all-2^32 active-bit theorem for F8 (2^14 states) and F9 (6,144-mask Lipmaa-Moriai check + 2^17 states), 4 x 2^26 full-scale vOW benchmark data (135,412 distinct claws), and live gated 16-CV vOW and full-32-bit claw trials inside the 2.8s organizer budget.

heuristics.statement: Conditioned on a deduplicated vOW claw (a0, u) satisfying W16(a0, u) = 0xbca1c321, W8 in F8, and W9 in F9, the reconstructed message pair satisfies the row-17 transition W17(a0, u) = 0x71e9ba98 in G17(0xbca1c321) with probability p17 = 2^-32, and conditioned on the full bridge event E_bridge = {W8 in F8, W9 in F9, W16 = 0xbca1c321, W17 = 0x71e9ba98}, the forward-to-tail conditional distribution of the remaining tail inputs (W0[8], W0[9], W0[18..23]) matches the uniform product measure on F8 x F9 x (Z/2^32Z)^6 sampled by the steps 18..38 SMC estimator and inverted downward by Phi^-1 = invert_rollout_to_sfs (by the exact 320-bit unitriangular bijection Phi of Theorem 2.2 and Corollary 2.3), so that the steps 18..38 differential tail (with step 20 evaluated on signed modular differences and full 8-word digest equality after step 38) succeeds with probability at least p_tail = 2^-76.55 (the 99% Student-t LCB across 64 zero-stall SMC seeds), giving total per-claw success probability p_claw = 2^-9.807707 * 2^-32 * 2^-76.55 = 2^-118.357707.
heuristics.scope: Conditional probability of the row-17 transition (p17 = 2^-32), forward-to-tail conditional distribution equivalence between forward claws conditioned on E_bridge and the downward SFS / tail SMC distribution on F8 x F9 x (Z/2^32Z)^6, and the steps 18..38 differential tail probability (p_tail >= 2^-76.55).
heuristics.extrapolation: Exact bit-by-bit enumeration (solve_row_exact) proves |G16| = 2 and |G17(0xbca1c321)| = 1 (0x71e9ba98). By Lemma 2.1(5), W17(a0, u) is randomized by sigma0(W2(a0, a1)) via step-2 terms absent from W16, W8, and W9; on the 135,412 vOW claws, byte matches to 0x71e9ba98 are [517, 486, 525, 526] vs 528.95 expected, 16-bit prefix matches are 4 vs 2.07 expected, conditional low-4-bit matches on F8 cap F9 are 13/157 = 0.0828 vs 0.0625 expected, and Trial 16 of experiment:r39-claw-vow gates unselected vOW low-4-bit W17 rate in [0.025, 0.115]. For forward-to-tail distribution equivalence, Theorem 2.2 and Corollary 2.3 prove that the forward map Phi : (CV1, a0, a1) -> (W0[8], W0[9], W0[16..23]) and downward SFS map Phi^-1 = invert_rollout_to_sfs form an exact 320-bit unitriangular measure-preserving bijection over (Z/2^32Z)^10 (verified live in both directions Phi^-1(Phi(.)) = id and Phi(Phi^-1(.)) = id on every active trial of experiment:r39-claw-vow and experiment:r39-tail-sfs), so conditioning uniform (CV1, a0, a1) on E_bridge induces the exact uniform product measure on F8 x F9 x (Z/2^32Z)^6 sampled by the tail SMC. For the steps 18..38 tail, 64 independent zero-stall SMC runs with N = 16,384 particles/stage (Table 7.1, 64/64 seeds, 0 stalls) give linear mean log2(mean(p_tail)) = -76.1838, linear 99% Student-t LCB = -76.3812, and log-scale 99% Student-t LCB = -76.5498 >= -76.55. In experiment:r39-tail-sfs, Trials 0..15 execute 16 strictly fixed-budget SMC replicas (N_part = 32, M_draws = 96, T_roll = 512 -> 16,384 rollouts/trial, 0 adaptive/while loops) and Trial 16 gates the 17th returned 39-step SFS colliding pair on tot_live_inverted >= 6 and -77.8 <= log2(mean_q) <= -74.5.
heuristics.limitations: Under the pseudorandomness of CV1 (H1) and vOW claw uniformity on the unconstrained schedule degrees of freedom, Theorem 2.2 and Corollary 2.3 make the forward-to-tail conditional distribution equivalence exact, and using the log-scale 99% Student-t LCB (-76.55) rather than the linear-scale 99% Student-t LCB (-76.3812) or point mean (-76.1838) provides a conservative 0.37-bit buffer against finite-sample SMC variance.
